# Footnotes

> **这页管什么**：尽量不用脚注；用交叉引用、note 或括号代替。
>
> 来源：<https://developers.google.com/style/footnotes> · CC BY 4.0 · 本文件是**规则摘要**，非原文全文。

## General

**Avoid footnotes.** They aren't accessible and present challenges for localization.

## Alternatives

- Add a cross-reference to related content.
- Use a formatted note callout.
- Place the information in a parenthetical within the sentence.

## If unavoidable

Use a superscript number — `<sup>1</sup>` — and put the footnote at the bottom of the page.
